# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance

## Validation

List the builds, tests, and manual checks that were actually performed. Include the Delphi version, target platform, and configuration for source changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one clear purpose.
- [ ] The documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Delphi source changes remain compatible with Delphi 10.4 Sydney.
- [ ] Generated files and unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] No credentials, private network details, or confidential data are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported privately instead of being added here.
- [ ] Relevant changelog and documentation entries are updated.
